name: Statistics Honours

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Once a STAT course has been completed with a grade of C- or higher, STAT courses that are prerequisites to this course may not be taken for further credit without permission of the department.

sections.title: Computing Recommendation
sections.note: Some experience with a high level programming language is recommended by the beginning of the second year.

sections.title: Accreditation of Courses
sections.note:
The Statistical Society of Canada has accredited certain courses within the department for partial fulfillment of the educational requirements for the associate statistician (AStat) designation.
The list of accredited courses is available at https://ssc.ca/sites/default/files/imce/2021_sfu_-_courses-sfu-summary-2021_1.pdf .
Please contact the department for details.
Further information on the professional statistician (PStat) and associate statistician (AStat) designations is available at https://www.ssc.ca/en/accreditation .

requirements.text: Students complete 120 units, including the lower division, upper division, and additional upper division requirements specified below.

requirements.title: 9 units from STAT 360, STAT 390, STAT 440 and 5 more
requirements.note: Nine units in additional upper division ACMA, MACM, MATH, RISK or STAT courses from List A below. Lists: List A.

sections.note: STAT courses (STAT 360 in particular) and MACM 316 are recommended.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must complete 16 additional upper division units to satisfy university requirements.
